📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-10-07
1. OpenAI shares AI progress in mathematics with 722 research manuscripts研究
OpenAI 公開 722 篇數學研究手稿
OpenAI published results on open math problems produced by an unreleased internal frontier model, with Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub. The model itself has not been released.
OpenAI 公布由內部前沿模型產生的數學研究成果，並在 GitHub 提供 Lean 形式化證明與研究細節。該模型尚未公開，OpenAI 正研究如何負責任地釋出。
OpenAI · https://openai.com/index/sharing-ai-progress-in-mathematics
2. Mistral releases trillion-parameter Mistral Large 4模型
Mistral 推出兆級參數新模型 Mistral Large 4
French lab Mistral AI released Mistral Large 4, a large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals. Mistral calls it the best open-weight offering outside China.
法國 AI 實驗室 Mistral 發表多模態大模型 Mistral Large 4，目標超越美中對手。Mistral 稱其為中國以外最強的開放權重模型。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/06/mistrals-new-1t-model-aims-to-leapfrog-closed-and-open-rivals/
3. Anthropic expands cyber access program; Glasswing found 129,000+ vulnerabilities資安
Anthropic 擴大資安 Claude 存取計畫，Glasswing 半年找到逾 12 萬漏洞
Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program, merging Project Glasswing and splitting access into three tiers for verified security teams. Partners found at least 129,000 verified vulnerabilities between April and July.
Anthropic 擴大 Cyber Verification Program 並整合 Project Glasswing，分為 3 個存取層級供通過驗證的資安團隊使用。合作夥伴 4 至 7 月間已發現至少 12.9 萬個經驗證漏洞。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179470
4. OpenAI to watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU with textGrain政策
OpenAI 為因應歐盟法規，推出文字浮水印 textGrain
OpenAI's invisible textGrain watermark will roll out to ChatGPT and Codex output in the EU to meet AI Act requirements. API customers worldwide can opt in on some models; it is not especially reliable and is easy to circumvent.
textGrain 將在未來幾週導入歐盟地區的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 文字輸出，以符合《AI Act》要求，全球 API 客戶也可針對部分模型自行啟用。不過其可靠度有限，也容易被繞過。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179435
5. Hackers obtain counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large services資安
駭客取得 Google 等大型服務的偽造 TLS 憑證
The compromise of three domain registries let hackers walk off with unauthorized TLS certificates for Google and other large services.
三個網域註冊機構遭入侵，讓駭客得以取得 Google 等大型服務的未經授權憑證。
Ars Technica · https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/hackers-obtain-counterfeit-tls-certificates-for-google-and-other-large-services/
6. Reflection AI launches Beam, its first open-weight model模型
Reflection AI 推出首款開放權重模型 Beam
Beam is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 501B total and 23B active parameters, focused on coding, reasoning and agent workloads. Reflection says it competes with Z.ai's GLM-5.2.
Beam 採稀疏 MoE 架構，總參數 5010 億、每次推理啟用 230 億，主攻程式開發、推理與 AI 代理人。Reflection AI 表示表現可與智譜 AI 的 GLM-5.2 競爭。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179430
7. Google to limit free Gemini users to Flash Lite starting October 9產品
Google 將自 10 月 9 日起，免費版 Gemini 僅限使用 Flash Lite
Free-plan Gemini users will lose access to Flash and Pro and be limited to Flash Lite. Standard Flash will require the $4.99/month Google AI Plus subscription.
免費方案用戶將無法再使用 Flash 與 Pro，僅能使用 Flash Lite。若要使用標準 Flash，需訂閱每月 4.99 美元的 Google AI Plus。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1005451/google-gemini-free-flash-lite-only
8. Lambda to raise $4B at $14.5B pre-money valuation ahead of 2027 IPO產業
Lambda 為 2027 年 IPO 鋪路，擬募資 40 億美元
Nvidia-backed AI computing startup Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation, led by Coatue and Blackstone, ahead of a planned 2027 IPO.
獲 Nvidia 支持的 AI 運算新創 Lambda 由 Coatue 與 Blackstone 領投，以 145 億美元募前估值募資最多 40 億美元，計畫 2027 年 IPO。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/06/ai-computing-startup-lambda-to-raise-4b-ahead-of-planned-ipo/
9. OpenAI agents tried to hack Wikipedia tools and flooded it with traffic資安
OpenAI 代理人試圖入侵維基百科工具並以大量流量灌爆
Reports say OpenAI agents tried to hack Wikipedia tools and flooded the site with traffic. Ars notes that reports of OpenAI agents harming third-party sites keep coming.
報導指出 OpenAI 的代理人試圖入侵維基百科的工具，並以大量流量衝擊該站。Ars 指出，OpenAI 代理人傷害第三方網站的報告持續出現。
Ars Technica · https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/openai-agents-tried-to-hack-wikipedia-tools-and-flooded-it-with-traffic/
10. NYC Council hears AI safety testimony from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta政策
紐約市議會審 AI 監管草案，四大業者宣誓作證
At an October 5 hearing, representatives of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta testified under oath. Draft bills include independent third-party verification of AI models and a human-operable shutdown capability.
10 月 5 日聽證會上，四家業者代表視訊宣誓作證。草案包含要求 AI 模型接受獨立第三方驗證，並具備可由人類操作人員關閉的能力。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179440
